sections.heading: Type power
lines: Rock moves and psychic moves are 1.3× stronger.

sections.heading: Move effects
lines: Core Enforcer, Crush Grip, Land's Wrath, Magnet Bomb, Precipice Blades, Smack Down, and Tectonic Rage: 2× stronger.

Ancient Power, Body Press, Body Slam, Circle Throw, Crabhammer, Dragon Rush, Fling, Grass Knot, Grav Apple, Hammer Arm, Heat Crash, Heavy Slam, Ice Hammer, Icicle Crash, Low Kick, Spacial Rend, Steamroller, Stomp, Storm Throw, Submission, Thousand Arrows, Thousand Waves, and Vital Throw: 1.5× stronger.

sections.heading: Standard moves and typing
lines: Mimicry and Camouflage turn Pokémon Ground-type.

sections.heading: Abilities
lines: Heavy Metal: Defense +1 and Speed −1 when it enters.
Light Metal: Speed +1 when it enters.
Slow Start: Attack +1, Defense +1, Special Defense +1, Speed −6, and evasiveness −6 when it enters.

sections.heading: Seed
lines: Telluric Seed: Defense +1 and becomes heavier.

sections.heading: More
lines: Rarer interactions of specific moves, abilities and items follow the Rejuvenation field rules and are not all listed here.
